answer: Each agent gets one payout credential from a registry that issues it only after a person completes a small, randomly assigned task at a public kiosk; the task changes daily, and the registry rate-limits issuance per verified person. A beacon announces the task, while a tundra outpost can verify it offline and sync later, even when a glacier blocks the road. Sybils must recruit distinct people and repeat the work, so attacks cost labor and coordination rather than just cheap accounts.
